faq.question: Do you only run ads for launches?
faq.answer: No. Launch work covers listing readiness, advertising structure, inventory timing, and early performance tracking so spend is not the only lever.

faq.question: Can you launch on multiple marketplaces?
faq.answer: Yes. Scope is confirmed during the audit. We support official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces and prioritize markets where listing, stock, and ads can be ready together.

faq.question: When should launch advertising start?
faq.answer: After the listing and offer are conversion-ready and inventory can support early demand. Starting earlier usually wastes budget.

faq.question: Is this available without full-service management?
faq.answer: Yes. Product launch support can run as a focused engagement or as part of full-service account management.

faq.question: What does the launch readiness review include?
faq.answer: We review listing quality, offer setup, inventory cover, advertising prerequisites, and the first-week success gates before recommending spend.

faq.question: How long does a typical launch engagement run?
faq.answer: Most launches run a readiness phase plus early stabilization weeks. Exact length depends on catalog readiness and stock lead times—confirmed during the audit.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com.
